description: Generates a report for a CONNECT event from the intelligence; identifies `cid` (campaign instance id) to be used for subsequent session calls in the same campaign process
name: campaignConnect

cid.description: The unique identifier of the campaign instance

report.description: My interpretation of our successful CONNECT events, including the detailed affect vector and any new distress flags, hooks and mood

affect_vector.description: The improvement of emotional connection over this conversation

label.description: The label/description of the affect vector, ex., 'alone -> felt understood'

evidence.description: The evidence for the affect vector, such as 'the visitor seems more engaged and responsive than before'

intensity.description: The intensity of the affect vector

distress_flags.description: Any noticed distress flags set by the visitor contact. Content that seems difficult for human; comma-delimited

hook.description: What's the most compelling argument for the visitor so far?

mood.description: What's the general mood of the visitor at this point?

stage.description: The stage of the visitor in the campaign process
